about: Configs npm run sim:check runs with the pinned gcsim (TODO 5.2). A config with `expected` must land within its tolerance of that mean DPS; one without only has to run cleanly. Community configs with a published DPS live in the rotation library (rotations/, ADR-0041), which sim:check runs after these.

configs.purpose: smoke: the binary runs a four-character config and writes a parseable result
